capabilities: Convert Markdown notes into WeChat-formatted articles
Sync articles directly to the WeChat draft box
Export multi-page social image cards as PNG
Create and overwrite Feishu cloud documents
Distribute articles to Zhihu, Juejin, CSDN and Xiaohongshu via a browser extension
disambiguation: Not only a WeChat converter: it also builds social image cards and distributes articles to Feishu, Zhihu, Juejin, Xiaohongshu and CSDN.
extras: Free and open source under MIT with optional donations; WeChat IP whitelisting may need the built-in relay or a self-hosted Cloudflare Worker, and multi-platform distribution depends on the companion browser extension rather than stored credentials.
motivation: The author wanted to solve the "last mile" problem of formatting notes for WeChat Official Accounts and Feishu Cloud Documents.
problem: Notes pasted into WeChat lose their formulas, diagrams and code styling, and each Chinese publishing platform needs its own manual reformatting.
summary: Markdown-to-WeChat formatter with live preview, draft sync, social image card export, and publishing to Feishu and other Chinese platforms.
